unmapped_findings: DP590-1 is an in-house (dashed-border) SEM dataset of hot-rolled dual-phase steel, classified as polycrystalline & multiphase for phase segmentation; it contains 23 images at 512 × 512 pixels with a real field of view of 36.56 × 36.56 µm (b0024; figure_001; b0036).

Segmentation comparison on DP590-1 (Table 3): MatSAM IoU 0.77 (±8.2%), F1 0.79 (±8.3%), Recall 0.81 (±14.7%); SAM IoU 0.75 (±13.4%), F1 0.85 (±9.2%), Recall 0.66 (±26.0%); OTSU IoU 0.64 (±9.7%), F1 0.68 (±11.3%), Recall 0.91 (±8.6%); Adaptive threshold IoU 0.48 (±5.3%), F1 0.49 (±8.9%), Recall 0.65 (±10.0%); no specialist method reported for DP590-1 (b0079).
MatSAM's IoU of 0.77 on DP590-1 is 13.0% higher than OTSU (0.64) and outperforms SAM (0.75) by 2.0% (b0072).
In Fig. 7(f), DP590-1 is a blurred grayscale image with grey blocky/elongated islands in a darker matrix; MatSAM extracts the islands as white blobs on black (figure_007).
